“John expressed concerns about reporting the bullying at school because his mom would get upset,” the officer wrote.

The officer said that he tried to contact the friend but that all of the numbers associated with the friend were disconnected or no longer in service. Another officer later went to the home and was also unable to speak with the friend, according to the report.

A little more than three years later, in 2025, John was punched multiple times by a man Nickerson had a relationship with, according to a Bend police report. The man fled when Nickerson called 911, she told police.

Nickerson said she had been arguing with the man about his involvement with other women when she placed all of his belongings outside her apartment. The man then came to the apartment, banged on the front door and eventually forced himself inside, according to the police report.
John told police that the man threatened to beat him and his mother up, according to the police report.
The domestic dispute turned physical when, John said, he tried to stand up for his mother as the man refused to leave the apartment, Nickerson told police.
The man “began to get violent, and I didn’t want him to hurt my mom at all,” John told police.

John said that he told the man he needed to leave and that the man shoved him twice, which made him drop his phone. When John went to pick up his phone, the man “bodyslammed” him to the ground, wrapping his arm around his head and neck, according to the report.
The man then punched John in the head about 12 to 14 times, John told the officer. The man left after he learned police would be on their way, according to the report.
Nickerson and John ultimately decided they did not want to cooperate in an investigation and pursue charges, saying the matter had been resolved, according to the report.

title: ‘Love Island USA’ Stars, Including Zach, Cheer on Kayda as She Closes Runway Show
summary: Kayda Bosse felt the love as she closed out the True Religion x Baby Phat runway show, while beau Zach Georgiou and Aniya Harvey cheered her on.
story: Kayda Bosse felt the love as she closed out the True Religion x Baby Phat runway show.
The “Love Island USA” Season 8 star strutted in a matching denim two-piece set, trimmed with faux fur as the brands celebrated their first-ever collaboration on Oct. 28 in Van Nuy, California.
The reality star-turned-model had her own cheering squad in the front row, which included beau Zach Georgiou, proving that they’re still going strong.
Also in attendance was Zach’s brother and fellow “Love Island USA” alum Charlie Georgiou, as well as Season 7’s Clarke Carraway and Season 6’s Sierra Mills.
Aniya Harvey, who also appeared on the same season as Kayda and Zach, was seen in the stands. She twinned with the same look that her fellow Islander wore.
During the runway show, Yume performed as the models showed off the collection. When it was Kayda’s turn to conclude the presentation, Zach was seen with his phone out and recording her.
The crowd and her friends cheered as she walked past them. Kayda smiled wide and stretched out her hand to Zach.
He posted video from his point of view on his Instagram story, adding a heart eye emoji.
It appears the couple, who came in fourth place, are still enjoying each other’s company. Just days before her fashion-filled moment, Kayda celebrated Zach’s birthday with a heartfelt post.

“To the guy I can be my truest self around,” she captioned a slideshow with photos of the two. “Your humor is one of the things I cherish most about you. You always find a way to make me smile in any situation. You have such a genuine way about you. I admire the person you are.”
She added that she hoped the “next chapter of your life brings you as much happiness as you bring to the people around you. Happy birthday Zacharias.”
In the comments, he replied, “Thankyou bby girl,” adding a red heart.

title: What Mel Robbins Makes of the ‘Make Them’ Theory In ‘Nobody Wants This’
summary: Mel Robbins has seen Nobody Wants This and heard of the Make Them theory. Here’s her response.
story: Mel Robbins has heard of the “make them” theory. In fact, she says she’s been trying it for years.
And it “does not work,” she tells TODAY.com backstage at Studio 1A Oct. 28.

In this season of “Nobody Wants This,” Morgan (Justine Lupe) goes viral for a solo episode of the podcast she usually co-hosts with her sister, Joanne (Kristen Bell). Riffing on Robbins’ “let them” theory, she proposes an alternative: Make them.

“Let them,” which is also the name of Robbins’ blockbuster book, is a type of surrender based on stoicism and ancient philosophy, Robbins says. In a previous interview with TODAY.com, she said the concept allows you to “see people exactly as they are instead of stressing yourself out wishing they were different.”
Morgan’s “make them” theory is exactly that opposite. Rather than let people do what they want, you make them do as you want.
Robbins watched “Nobody Wants This” and was moved by the apparent reference, because she says it’s proof her book is now “part of culture.”
Below, Robbins unpacks “make them” vs. “let them,” her new People Magazine cover and whether her three kids take her famous advice in conversation with TODAY.com.

I have used the “make them” method for 54 years. I have tried to make them do the dishes, make them lose weight, make them change their mind, make them go to therapy, make them do their homework, and that does not work. What ends up happening when you try to make somebody change is they resist the thing you’re making them do.

I think it’s amazing and fun and funny, but it’s the way we’re all going through life right now, which is why we’re all so stressed out and why we’re all frustrated in our relationships and with other people.

I find it’s much more strategic to work with the neuroscience, and just let people have the dignity of their own experience. Let people reveal who they are to you, and let them see your example. A funny thing happens, and this isn’t my theory, it’s actual hard science. When somebody has the space to sit with themselves, and when somebody does not feel pressured to change, they suddenly believe it’s their idea. They suddenly have room to step toward the things that you’ve been b----- about forever, because nobody wants to be told, “I told you so.”

I love the show, and I love everybody on it, and I was super flattered. I have created a simple theory that explains stoicism and radical acceptance and Buddhism and the serenity prayer, because that’s what the “let them” theory is.

When you see people not only apply it, but it becomes part of culture ... you see people make jokes about it — you know you have shared something that is of value. If it’s something simple, if it works, if it’s sticky, so people can remember it, that’s what makes for a really good idea.

No, absolutely not. I’m their mother. Why would they listen to me? They are biologically engineered to argue against and resist everything I try to make them do. I have learned the single best piece of advice in my 50s that I wish I had had when I was born, and it’s this. Every parent should just repeat this sentence: Do you want my advice, or do you just want me to listen? Ninety-nine percent of the time, your children and everybody in your life just wants you to listen.
But no, my children don’t listen to me.

You cannot tell somebody the lesson they have to learn by failing or experiencing the pain of doing it your way. You just can’t. Some lessons cannot be transferred through language. They have to be learned through experience.
As moms in particular, we’re trying to prevent you from experiencing the pain that we’ve experienced. The irony is, the exact pain you need to learn the lesson, we can’t teach.
We’re a couple days away from Halloween right now. It feels like I’m in a costume. I’ve never imagined a moment where I would be on the cover of People.

To see something this big happen in my career, and to know that it’s happening because of all of the work that I did to change myself and become a person that is someone that I’m proud of, and then just sharing what I’m learning to be celebrated for the work that we can all do to change our lives — that’s incredible.

I’m just very proud. I’m so happy that the 41-year-old depressed, insecure, jealous, loser version of me got herself together and decided that she was worth working on, and her life was worth making better. Inside each of us, there is the desire to thrive. There is the desire to contribute. There is the desire to be happy. And I hope, in some small way, that this article and seeing how far one person can come in their life in 15, 16 years, and the positive difference that you can make — I hope it inspires somebody to make a decision to make their life better while they can.

I woke up dumb every day. Really dumb. If you think about it, if you’re really honest with yourself, there are things that you’re doing right now that are dumb, and they’re embarrassing. If you really stop and say, “OK, I can do better. I can take better care of myself. I can learn how to have a positive attitude. I don’t have to hang out with negative idiots. ... The time I’m spending complaining and feeling sorry for myself is time I could actually invest in changing my mindset and my habits.”

When you do that, you immediately become a different person. The results take time, but you start to feel differently the moment you act differently. I think that’s what shocked me the most. I stayed miserable for a long time. It’s pretty surprising how different and how much better you can feel in a very short period of time simply by changing how you act every day.

title: Elizabeth Holmes Told TODAY in 2016 She Had ‘No Doubt’ Her Company Would Survive
summary: Elizabeth Holmes spoke with TODAY in 2016 amid accusations that her Theranos technology was faulty.
story: Welcome to the “TODAY Archives,” where we revisit memories from our show when celebrities and newsmakers started discourse, made us laugh or shaped our culture. This latest installment features Eliazbeth Holmes being interviewed in 2016.

Elizabeth Holmes has once again found herself in the public eye, thanks to the film “You Can See Everything.” The documentary, which follows her weeks before she begins her prison sentence, earned $15 million in its opening weekend earlier this month, the most for a debut weekend for a non-music doc since Michael Moore’s 2004 movie, “Fahrenheit 9/11.”

Holmes is the founder and former CEO of Theranos, a company that sought to revolutionize blood testing, partnering with Walgreens to offer fast in-store blood tests for more than 20 diseases at a cheaper price than what they traditionally cost, due to secret technology. Holmes raised nearly $1 billion and the company was once valued at $9 billion, bringing her wealth and fame among the Silicon Valley set.

Accusations, however, came out that Theranos’ technology was faulty and Holmes was convicted in 2022 of four federal charges of wire fraud for misrepresenting to investors what the Theranos technology could do.
In 2016, then-NBC special anchor Maria Shriver sat down with Holmes to discuss the questions that emerged about her product’s accuracy.
Elizabeth Holmes Defended Theranos

After reports began circulating about the methods Theranos used, Holmes discussed her company in an interview that aired April 16, 2016, in which she opened up about the growing controversy over her company.
“I’m a better person for it, and I’m a better leader,” she said.
Holmes defended Theranos and the blood testing methods it used.
“It’s affordable,” she said. “That means it’s transparent in terms of pricing. That means that it’s available to people as a basic right, early, before they’re sick.”
What Did Elizabeth Holmes Say About the Negative Reports?
In 2015, the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services found multiple violations at one of Holmes’ labs which presented a threat to the safety of patients.
“I feel devastated that we did not catch and fix these issues faster,” she said.
Holmes said the buck has to stop with her.

“I’m the founder and CEO of this company. Anything that happens in this company is my responsibility,” she said. “At the end of the day, we stop testing and have taken the approach of saying, ‘Let’s rebuild this entire laboratory from scratch, so that we can ensure it never happens again.’”
Elizabeth Holmes Believed in the Future of Theranos
Holmes said she thought the correct policies were in place, but added she was “absolutely” sure Theranos would withstand all its issues and survive.
“No doubt. I know what we’ve built, and I know what we’ve created, and I know what it means to people, and it is a change that needs to happen in the world,” she said.

title: ‘Wicker’ Had the Internet Thirsting, But Olivia Colman, Alexander Skarsgård Say the Film Is About More Than Lust
summary: Olivia Colman and Alexander Skarsgård explained the ending of “Wicker” and how their characters went from lust to love.
story: Spoilers ahead for “Wicker” starring Olivia Colman and Alexander Skarsgård.

When the trailer for “Wicker” was released, the internet began thirsting over Alexander Skarsgård’s willow-woven leading man. That’s because the NSFW teaser featured the actor alongside Olivia Colman getting, well, down and dirty and breaking beds to the shock of the townspeople and viewers.

But the film is more than just a satirical comedy about sex with a wickedly handsome wicker man. Instead, it shows the intimacy, vulnerability and trust required to open one’s heart to love. Its emotional ending proves that despite the challenges in marriages and the outside noise, love conquers all.

“It’s a beautiful love story that’s funny and irreverent, but set in a fantastical world that (Alex Huston Fischer and Eleanor Wilson), our writers, directors, created with extraordinary collaborators,” Skarsgård tells TODAY.com. “But with a lot of social commentary about patriarchy and social hierarchy and the institution of marriage, but done with so much levity and a light touch.”
What Is ‘Wicker’ About?

“Wicker,” out now, stars Colman as an independent yet lonely Fisherwoman, constantly ostracized by villagers. When asked if she’s “caught herself a lover,” she says, “Love seems more burden than a prize.”

But when the Fisherwoman has a change of heart, she requests the local Basketmaker (Peter Dinklage) to make her a husband. Woven from willow with broad-shoulders, strong arms and incredible, umm, assets, the wicker man is “gentle-spoken and utterly devoted.” That’s how author Ursula Wills describes him in her short story “The Wicker Husband,” which the movie is based on.

“I love her and admire her,” Colman tells TODAY.com of her character. “She has strengths in her solitude and she’s got her own agency, and she’s amazing. But she has armor. She’s been mocked her whole life and she ignores it, which is admirable. But at some point she did go, ‘I’ve had enough. I’m going to have the last laugh.’”
What the Fisherwoman doesn’t realize, Colman says, is “that she’s going to fall in love.”

That journey rocks Fisherwoman, and the townsfolk, to the core. As she opens herself up to love — “it’s terrifying doing that,” she says — she also faces more scrutiny and jealousy from those around her.

“It’s lust, initially, isn’t it?” Colman says about the early relationship between Fisherwoman and her Wicker Husband, adding that her character does eventually “fall in love with someone who’s marvelous.”
“They learn about love together,” she says.
Skarsgård brings to light one of the Fisherwoman’s most intimate quotes from the film to showcase her journey.

“Fisherwoman tells the Wicker Husband, ‘You have my heart now,’ and that’s what’s scary about it. Your heart is in someone else’s hands, and your happiness is in their hands,” Skarsgård says. “There’s a lot of beauty in that, but it’s also scary because you know that you can get hurt.”
Having been on her own her whole life, Colman says Fisherwoman’s relationship with Wicker Husband goes from lust to love when she realizes he’s someone she can lean on.
The turning point begins when one morning, after a night of enjoying their marriage, the Wicker Husband says, “The bed is broken. Bring me a hammer. I will fix it.”
“Their days are nicer when they’re together. They enhance each other rather than take from each other,” Colman says.
How Does ‘Wicker’ End?

Their marriage, however, makes the townspeople insecure, questioning their own marriages. The women see how Wicker Husband is so attentive, caring and goes out of his way to make Fisherwoman’s life better. The husbands feel threatened and angry towards Wicker Husband for highlighting their faults.

Their relationship irritates the Tailor’s Wife (Elizabeth Debicki) the most. The queen bee of the town, Tailor’s Wife seemingly has it all: a hard working husband and wonderful children. But she’s a homemaker with dreams of having her own identity.

She envies Fisherwoman’s independence and how she has a supportive partner. So when her sister’s husband dies and the young widow asks the Basketmaker to weave her a baby, the Tailor’s Wife devises a plan to separate Fisherwoman and Wicker Husband.

The Tailor’s Wife implies that Wicker Husband has been unfaithful. Fisherwoman gets caught up in the lies and rumors, and when she sees the Wicker Baby, she becomes completely distraught. She believes her loyal husband has betrayed her, which he has not.

“Mourning is the price we pay for love. So unfortunately, if you love deeply, it’s going to feel awful when it’s not there,” Colman says. “But would you ever say no to the love in the first place? I wouldn’t. It’s a terrible leap of faith, but worth doing.”
What happens next shows viewers how it’s easier to believe the bad than the good, one of the film’s themes. The Fisherwoman throws fire on her delicate partner, who runs away engulfed in flames.
“Not her finest hour, definitely,” quips Colman.
Heartbroken, she attempts to continue her life as before. But love has changed her, and losing that love has destroyed her.

When Basketmaker finds a badly burned and almost destroyed Wicker Husband in the woods, he mends him. The Tailor Wife’s Sister, meanwhile, has had a mental breakdown and has abandoned her Wicker Baby, only to be found by Fisherwoman.
When Basketmaker sees the Fisherwoman, he reminds her that Wicker Husbands can’t have Wicker Babies, implying that her adoring spouse did not cheat.

In the end, in an act of revenge, Basketmaker shakes up the town by offering a Wicker Wife to the highest bidder. The villagers show their true and disgusting colors, showing the craftsman the lengths they will go to to have their own serviceable companion. However, the Wicker Wife is made of blackthorn, a thorny shrub, and the (un)lucky winner appears to be mutilated by his new beloved when she goes in for a kiss.

As for the Fisherwoman, she is reunited with her Wicker Husband, who reminds her that she is the only one for him. With their adopted Wicker Baby, they decide to leave town and start a new life together away from the spiteful townspeople.

title: Wynonna Judd Says She Plans to Visit Estranged Daughter Grace
summary: Wynonna Judd isn’t giving up hope of repairing her relationship with her estranged daughter, Grace Kelley. She reveals plans to visit her in prison to Hoda Kotb in an episode of Making Space.
story: Wynonna Judd isn’t giving up hope of repairing her relationship with her estranged daughter, Grace Kelley.

In a candid conversation with Hoda Kotb on the Oct. 28 episode of the “Making Space” podcast, the country music star revealed that she plans to visit her daughter again — and made it clear that no matter how much time passes, she’ll never stop hoping for a relationship.
When asked if reconciliation is possible, Judd replied without hesitation: “Absolutely.”
“I’m going to go see her at some point,” she added. “I’m going to do it with as much presence as I can in this situation.”
Judd went on to explain that she used to visit Kelley every week in prison, which inspired the song “Drive” on her new album, “The Hard Truth,” released Oct. 2, 2026.

Kelley has struggled with addiction and legal troubles over the years and is currently serving a 15-month sentence at a Virginia jail after pleading guilty to driving with a suspended or revoked license in June 2026.
Judd said that they became estranged after she stopped providing financial support.

“I bought her five cars, and I gave her money for food and shelter, and yet she spent it on drugs. I can’t stop that, but I can say no,” she told Kotb. “Once the money ran out, she did too. She cut me off.”
Kotb asked whether Judd feels guilty about the situation.
“Every day,” Judd answered. “I carry it because I think, what could I have done differently?”
She reflected on raising her children while touring at the height of her career and wondered whether she should have taken more time off.
“I think it’s the hardest thing I’ve ever done,” Judd told Kotb. “I don’t know how in the world I’m doing it at times. Letting go of my daughter, letting her find her way.”
“I miss her, and I want her back,” she said.
Kotb asked Judd what she would say to other parents who are estranged from their children.
“Never give up on them. They’re alive,” she said.
She explained that she’s ready if Kelley wants to return to her life, but that she also needs to maintain the boundaries she has set.

“I’m devastated, but I also know that she’s got to figure it out for herself,” she said. “If Grace wants back into my life, I’m ready, and I love her dearly. I miss her every second of every breath that I take as a mom.”
“I am going to be one of those that will die hoping”

title: ‘DWTS’ Horror Movie Night Shocks Fans With Shirley Ballas’ Brutal Scores, Double Elimination
summary: See the scores and who got eliminated during the “DWTS” Horror Movie Night episode of Oct. 27.
story: Spooky season was officially in session on “Dancing With the Stars.”
The Tuesday, Oct. 27, episode brought out killer choreography for Horror Movie Night, where the remaining 10 couples performed routines inspired by legendary horror films.
After last week’s Dedication Night ended with no elimination, the pairs had to work twice as hard to avoid being cut from the competition.
After an eerie opening number by the eliminated pros, co-hosts Alfonso Ribeiro and Julianne Hough kicked off the show, which also saw the return of Val Chmerkovskiy after his one week suspension.
Joining Carrie Ann Inaba, Bruno Tonioli and Derek Hough this week as guest judge was “Dancing with the Stars: The Next Pro” judge, and Mark Ballas’ mom, Shirley Ballas.
Read all about what went down during the Oct. 27 episode of “DWTS,” including the dances and scores of each couple.

Julia Stiles was up first with an Argentine tango, saying she felt defeated during rehearsals and pressured by partner Ezra Sosa. When they got on the ballroom floor, the results were mixed from judges who felt she held back. But it was Shirley Ballas who stunned the couple (and everyone else) when she gave them a 4 out of 10. Inaba and Derek Hough gave them a 7, while Tonioli dished out an 8.

When Harry Shum Jr. and partner Jenna Johnson performed their contemporary, they blew the judges, including Shirley Ballas away, who said she’d never seen anything like that before. But did her comments translate to her score? Yes, the couple got the first perfect score of the season.
The guest judge continued with tough criticisms when it came to Tatyana Ali and Jan Ravnik. She said it didn’t include enough paso doble content and gave them a 4 out of 10.

Contemporary proved to be a crowd pleaser during the night. Connor Wood and Rylee Arnold’s routine got the judges really excited, calling it his best performance yet. Jackson Olson and Emma Slater’s performance was also filled with action and great remarks.

When it came to judging her son and partner Maura Higgins, Shirley Ballas did not hold back. She was in tune with how her fellow judges felt, noting she enjoyed the lifts, believed it was powerful but to work on her feet.
After being suspended for since-deleted comments about Inaba’s critiques about a lift in wife Johnson’s routine during the Oct. 13 episode, the pro returned to dance with partner Jenna Dewan.
During rehearsals, Chmerkovskiy apologized for having to miss an episode. “We are back together. I am so sorry for all the chaos,” he told Dewan. “You did not sign up for that and I feel awful.”
The actor forgave him and told him she missed him.

title: ‘DWTS’ Judge Carrie Ann Inaba Breaks Her Silence Over Jenna Johnson Lift Criticism
summary: Carrie Ann Inaba is speaking out for the first time since a comment about a lift led to the most drama the “Dancing With the Stars” franchise has seen in years.
story: Carrie Ann Inaba is speaking out for the first time since a comment about a lift led to the most drama the “Dancing With the Stars” franchise has seen in years.

On Oct. 24, the “DWTS” judge shared a carousel of behind-the-scenes photos on Instagram while reflecting on the emotional performances she witnessed during the Dedication Night episode on Oct. 20. One of the pictures showed her embracing pro Jenna Johnson, whom she had an intense moment with during the Super Bowl Night episode on Oct. 13.
A day later, Inaba returned to the post and addressed the back-and-forth she had with Johnson in a comment.

“I have not (spoken) about what happened because of professional courtesy for those who are still competing, and we actually have standards and practices that keep us separated,” she wrote. “But I think a part of this ‘headline’ has missed a few important parts of what happened. I think it’s important for everyone to know that Jenna and I hugged it out after the Super Bowl show.”
Inaba complimented Johnson for her response to the situation.

“Jenna was an absolute professional about it, and two women worked through the moment,” she praised. “It came to my attention later that Jenna was deeply hurt. So I also offered to speak with her at anytime.”

The judge then called attention to the lift rule that impacts some dances. Over the years, Inaba has become known as a stickler when it comes to the lift rule, calling out pros when they add one to a dance style when it isn’t allowed.

“I have also offered to discuss the lift rule and how I enforce it. @sharnaburgess made a great video explaining lifts, assists and which dances allow and don’t allow them,” she continued, mentioning pro Sharna Burgess.
In another comment, Inaba explained how she would like a “new lift rule” to be implemented next season.

“I think a session (with) all the dancers and the judges in a room together to discuss the history of how and why Len Goodman, our original producers and I defined the lift rule and (what) the purpose is which is safety and fairness,” she suggested. “The show has evolved tremendously, the way the show is cast has also changed, and so has our audience and the way they consume the show.”
Inaba concluded, “So, working together to create a better understanding between the dancers and the judges and our audience is important to me, as we move forward and is something I have asked for.”
The controversy surrounding the lift began after Inaba provided feedback on Johnson’s samba routine with partner Harry Shum Jr. in the Oct. 13 episode.

“A lift is, I just need to say it,” Inaba said before referring to her notes and reading a definition. “Any movement during which one of the dancers has both feet off the floor at the same time with the assistance or support of their partner. Yeah, lift.”

Following the awkward exchange, Johnson’s husband, fellow pro Val Chmerkovskiy, fired back on social media. In a since-deleted post, he shared a picture on his Instagram story with a caption that read, “You almost saw Fresh Prince enter the ballroom last night,” seeming referring to Will Smith’s infamous slap at the 2022 Academy Awards.
Chmerkovskiy posted an apology on his Instagram story Oct. 15, sharing that he reached out to Inaba, E! News reported.
He was given a one-week suspension from the show two days later.

“The well-being of everyone who works on ‘Dancing with the Stars’ is non-negotiable,” BBC Studios said in a statement to NBC News. “Val’s social media post was inappropriate and does not reflect the values or standards expected of anyone connected with the show. As a result, he will not participate in next week’s show.”
TODAY.com confirmed that Chmerkovskiy’s suspension was not the result of an HR complaint filed by Inaba.

After reports of his suspension, he released a statement on his Instagram story that read, “In a moment where my instinct was to defend my wife, I made a poor decision to reference a meme to ‘keep my wife’s name’ out of the conversation, without stopping to think through what else that reference could imply which was genuinely never my intention.”

He added, “Carrie Ann certainly didn’t deserve to get caught in the middle of my bad judgment, and I hate that she was. The last thing I want is to become a distraction from an important week or from the incredible work my dance partner Jenna Dewan is putting in. Please send Carrie Ann, Jenna, and the whole ‘DWTS’ family lots of love during Dedication Night. I’ll be watching and cheering everyone on!!”
Chmerkovskiy was briefly replaced by pro Alan Bersten. He will return to the ballroom to dance with Dewan in the Oct. 27 episode.

title: Alfonso Ribeiro Shares His Favorite Holiday Memory and Gift That Unlocked His ‘Wild Side’
summary: Alfonso Ribeiro shares a holiday memory from when he was child and how he is looking forward to spending the end of the year.
story: The holidays are all about family for Alfonso Ribeiro.
The actor and “Dancing With the Stars” co-host is looking forward to creating new memories with his four children, wife Angela, and his two pups Aksel and Ace.
But before he looks ahead, he’s reminiscing about one of his favorite memories from when he was a child and growing up in New York.
“I remember when I was probably 10 or 11, in the Bronx, and my my dad bought me a three wheeler,” Ribeiro tells TODAY.com. “And I’m talking like a motorized three wheeler.”
That gift, the “Fresh Prince of Bel-Air” star says, gave him a newfound sense of freedom and even unlocked a side of him he’s never had before.

“I was just rip, roaring, tearing through the neighborhood in the snow in New York with this thing. It was a great memory,” he says, adding, “The wild side of Alfonso started right there. It was super cool.”
And aside from celebrating weekly themes on “DWTS,” Ribeiro has also kickstarted the festive season with his new partnership.

He teamed up with Pedigree brand and Walmart for their Pedigree Pawliday Portrait Studio. At select locations, families can get in the holiday spirit and enjoy a ‘90s-inspired professional photo shoot with their furry friends. For those unable to make it to a studio, people can send in their family portraits from home and win a hand-painted re-creation.

“How can you have a portrait of your family without your dogs being part of it?” the “America’s Funniest Home Video” host says. “Our dogs are family and it’s nice to be able to include them in those family photos.”
While Ribeiro already did a session with Aksel and Ace, he notes that he and his whole family “are going to have to do some more.”

title: EXCLUSIVE: Andrew Rannells Told TODAY What to Expect From the ‘Girls’ Reboot
summary: Andrew Rannells talked on TODAY with Jenna & Sheinelle about what to expect from the “Girls” reboot.
story: Andrew Rannells is giving fans of “Girls” an inside look at what they may see when the show’s reboot comes out.

According to Rannells, the idea for the reboot grew after the launch of “Girls” star and creator Lena Dunham’s book, “Famesick,” earlier this year. Rannells said audiences during the book tour were “so excited to see us together on stage.”

“I think (it) maybe kickstarted Lena’s idea that, ‘I think maybe this is time,’ because we certainly didn’t want to come back before people were ready,” he said Oct. 27 on TODAY with Jenna & Sheinelle.

Rannells, who played Elijah Krantz on “Girls,” was asked if the reboot would have a different visual look from the original, like “Bel-Air” or “A Different World,” or if it would appear similar to the original, like “Sex and the City,” leading him to opine about where the characters may be today.

“I think it’ll look and sort of feel the same,” he said. “But, you know, when we left these characters, they were what about to be mid-20s, late 20s? They’re 40 now. So, now we have to sort of explore that. So I think it’s a good time. I think that she chose the right moment. So I’m really excited.”

Dunham announced the reboot of the Emmy-winning series in a video on Oct. 13 shared on HBO Max’s social media accounts. In the clip, she hopped on a call with co-stars Allison Williams, Zosia Mamet and Jemima Kirke.
“We used to spend, like, every summer together, you know, doing this thing that we do, making the show. Is it something that you would want to do again? Are you free next summer?” Dunham asked them.
Rannells, in the announcement, crashed the call to confirm he’d be joining the reboot.
“I’m in, but only ‘cause you trash cans need constant supervision,” he joked.

“Girls” revolved around four 20-something friends living in New York City and ran for six seasons from 2012 to 2017. In a press release, HBO said production should get underway in 2027 and the show will take place a decade after the events of the final episode from Season 6.

“We always said we would only return to ‘Girls’ if there was a specific story we were burning to tell. I’ve missed these characters, but for a long time I couldn’t quite picture them in the present day. Then, right around my 40th birthday, they started talking to me in the shower,” Dunham said in a statement.
It’s unclear if Adam Driver, who played the romantic interest of Dunham’s character, Hannah, will return. TODAY.com had reached out to him for a comment about the revival, but did not hear back.

title: Matthew Perry’s ‘Friends’ Co-Stars Showed Up to His Funeral Together, Walked to the Casket ‘Holding Hands’
summary: Matthew Perry’s sister said his Friends co-stars had a show of solidarity.
story: Matthew Perry’s sister recalled that when their family was grieving his loss, his “Friends” were there to console them as they shared their own heartbreak.
Mia Perry Bowick shares a poignant memory from Perry’s funeral in the new three-part Netflix docuseries “The One About Matthew Perry.”
She says in the third episode of the show that their family had arranged his 2023 funeral to be open casket “for a little while” so the family could say goodbye.
“That was when I completely broke down,” she says in the show.

The “Friends” star was found dead on Oct. 28, 2023. His cause of death was later revealed to be the acute effects of ketamine, with contributing factors including drowning, coronary artery disease and the effects of buprenorphine, a medication that’s used to treat opioid use disorder.
Bowick says in the docuseries that his funeral was just close friends and family, which included “Friends” castmates Jennifer Aniston, Matt LeBlanc, David Schwimmer, Lisa Kudrow and Courteney Cox.

“I remember sitting in the front row with our family and seeing his mom and all the other siblings, and then the rest of the ‘Friends’ cast all walked in together,” Bowick recalls in the docuseries. “I hadn’t seem them in easily 20 years. Jen Aniston was the first one of them to come up to me and give me a huge hug, but they all did. And then all five of them walked up to the casket holding hands and stood around him crying.”
The cast of “Friends” released a statement on Oct. 30, 2023, after Perry’s death.

“We are all so utterly devastated by the loss of Matthew. We were more than just cast mates. We are a family,” the statement said. “There is so much to say, but right now we’re going to take a moment to grieve and process this unfathomable loss.”
“In time we will say more, as and when we are able,” the statement continued. “For now, our thoughts and our love are with Matty’s family, his friends, and everyone who loved him around the world.”
Sitcom director Jim Burrows, who directed more than a dozen episodes of “Friends,” said on TODAY following Perry’s death that the cast was “destroyed” after learning of his passing.
In the docuseries, Bowick also remembers a funny yet “inappropriate” moment that occurred when Perry’s body was being transferred to a mausoleum. It embodied the spirit of Perry’s comedy and timing.

“That was the first time I felt Matthew with me, and he showed up right behind my right shoulder and leaned over my shoulder and goes, ‘How f----- up is this?’” she says in the show. “I started laughing so hard. I was like, ‘Oh my God, there he is making me laugh at the most horrible moment,’ and also incredibly inappropriate for me to start laughing while they’re putting him into this thing. But I just started cracking up, and I was like, ‘Yeah man, this is pretty f----- up.’”
That comic voice in her ear has stayed with her since his tragic loss. During an appearance on TODAY Oct. 26, Bowick described Perry as a “constance presence” in her family’s lives.
“I do still talk to him,” she said.
Perry’s obsession with Batman also has served as a signal of his spirit to his family and friends.
“It’s just like an automatic association anytime I see the little Batman symbol,” Bowick told TODAY.com.

title: Noah Wyle Is People’s Sexiest Man! See Every Winner Since 1985 (and How They Reacted)
summary: Here is every single winner of People’s Sexiest Man Alive from 1985 to now, when Noah Wyle was named the winner.
story: People just announced its 2026 Sexiest Man Alive. The man taking the reigning crown from Jonathan Bailey, who won last year? None other than Noah Wyle, star of “The Pitt,” which returned for its second season earlier this year.
Since the magazine began honoring Hollywood’s best-looking men in 1985 when it named Mel Gibson the Sexiest Man Alive, nearly three dozen other celebrities have held the title.

Three of those men — Brad Pitt, George Clooney and Johnny Depp — have won the title twice. Richard Gere made the list twice, too, but the first time around, in 1993, he was honored along with his then-wife, supermodel Cindy Crawford, as the Sexiest Couple Alive.
Only one celebrity won the title retroactively: Keanu Reeves, who in 2015 was named the Sexiest Man Alive for 1994. (More on that below!)
Here’s everyone who has won People’s Sexiest Man Alive title.
1985 — Mel Gibson

Gibson was crowned People’s first Sexiest Man Alive back in 1985. Gibson had already dazzled movie audiences as both as an action star in the first several “Mad Max” franchise movies and a dramatic actor in “The Year of Living Dangerously” and “The Bounty,” among others.

Though the actor’s career would continue to boom — that is, before legal issues and controversies derailed it decades later — the actor already had the sense that fame could prove to be a handful. “It’s all happening too fast,” he told People at the time.
1986 — Mark Harmon
When Harmon won the title, he was one of television’s biggest stars thanks to his role as Dr. Robert Caldwell on the medical drama “St. Elsewhere.”
The former college football star told People at the time that he couldn’t comprehend his physical appeal. “All I see is a bunch of fake teeth and football scars,” he said.

In 2015, Harmon told People that shortly after he won the title, he and his buddies were treated to a funny surprise. “I’d done an interview with People about leaving ‘St. Elsewhere’ and I went up to play basketball and both backboards on either side of the court were plastered with the (Sexiest Man Alive) cover.”
1987 — Harry Hamlin

Hamlin was one of the stars of the hit legal drama “L.A. Law” when he won the title in 1987. The modest actor told the magazine, “Certainly when I look in the mirror, I don’t get turned on,” and noted his looks were “not something I spend a lot of time considering.”

Years later, Hamlin showed off his sense of humor when he did a guest arc (alongside real-life wife Lisa Rinna) on the mid-2000s whodunnit series “Veronica Mars.” Hamlin portrayed an off-the-rails Hollywood star who brags about his winning a Sexiest Man Alive title in the 1980s.
1988 — John F. Kennedy Jr.
The first non-professional actor to win the Sexiest Man Alive title, the late Kennedy was a law student at New York University School of Law when he was crowned in 1988.
People’s breathless story about Kennedy at the time celebrated his physical attributes (including his “extraordinarily defined thighs”), his charisma and his social conscience.

“It is not merely his looks — his mother’s dark eyes and his father’s striking body. (He’s 6’1″ 187 lbs.) It is that he has something that no film star, no athlete, can duplicate — the aura, the excitement that charges a room when he enters it, simply by virtue of being Kennedy,” it read.
1n July 1999, Kennedy, his wife, Carolyn, and his sister-in-law Lauren died when a plane he was piloting crashed near Martha’s Vineyard.
1989 — Sean Connery
“For once, I’m speechless,” then-59-year-old Connery told People after learning he won the title. “It’ll all be downhill from here!”
It was not actually downhill from there for Connery. The following year, he played Michelle Pfeiffer’s lover in “The Russia House.” He still holds the record for the oldest man to win the title.
1990 — Tom Cruise

Cruise won the title during the early years of his Hollywood mega-success after proving to be a box-office superstar while earning critical raves for “Risky Business,” “Top Gun,” “Rain Man,” “The Color of Money” and “Born on the Fourth of July.”

Cruise’s “Rain Man” co-star Valeria Golino told People that the actor’s most mesmerizing attribute was his eyes. “Not their color. His regard — the way he looks with them. They’re very alive,” she said.
1991 — Patrick Swayze
When “Dirty Dancing” star Swayze was named the Sexiest Man Alive in 1991, his mom, Patsy Swayze, told the magazine that her son “knows he’s just an ordinary, down-home Texas kid.”
“He doesn’t think that his job deserves all that idolatry — if you want to call it that,” she added.

Swayze’s “Ghost” co-star Demi Moore singled out Swayze’s “gentle” personality as one of his finest qualities. “He has a very sweet, gentle, kind heart, and those Southern manners,” Moore told People. “But he’s also got a very rugged, animalistic physique.”
1992 — Nick Nolte

Nolte reportedly had a hard time believing he’d been named the Sexiest Man Alive. When the magazine notified the “Prince of Tides” star of his win, he responded “Are you sure you didn’t make a mistake? My personal choice is Walter Cronkite,” according to the Associated Press.
1993 — Richard Gere and Cindy Crawford

In 1993, instead of naming a sexiest man, People named a Hollywood power couple the “Sexiest Couple Alive.” Supermodel Cindy Crawford, then 27, and actor Richard Gere, then 44, were a “laid-back duo” at the time. They’d go on to split up a year later.
“Richard loves me without my makeup and in my ponytail,” Crawford told the outlet at the time. “So, hey, if it’s good enough for him, it’s good enough for me.”
1994 — Keanu Reeves*

Technically, People didn’t name anyone the sexiest man (or couple) alive in the year of 1994. However, in 2015, the magazine righted that wrong. Then the editorial director, Jess Cagle, retroactively handed Keanu Reeves the title.
1995 — Brad Pitt
Pitt won his first Sexiest Man Alive title — yep, there would be more — in 1995 when he was one of Hollywood’s most eligible bachelors.
In 2011, the “Legends of the Fall” star later told Entertainment Weekly that winning the honor threw him for a loop.

“I was really uncomfortable. What does it mean? What are you talking about?” said Pitt, “I’ve always been mistrustful of my own hubris, and it put me on guard. Like, it was dangerous. What do they say? Don’t believe your own hype.”

He added, “When you get older, you realize it’s just for fun. (George) Clooney and I were able to have fun with it later. But in some ways, I’m still a kid from Missouri and Oklahoma and I’m trying to find my way. By the way, we’re only talking about a blip. I didn’t spend much time thinking about it.”
1996 — Denzel Washington
Washington proved to be humble when he won the title in 1996. “I don’t take myself too seriously,” he told People at the time. “I don’t stop in the mirror and go, ‘Hey, Sexy Man.’”
Washington’s “Courage Under Fire” co-star Regina Taylor summed up his appeal for the publication. “He has wit, style and intelligence,” said Taylor.
1997 — George Clooney
Like his buddy Pitt, Clooney has also won the title twice, the first time in 1997.

“The rap on George is that he’s this rake, this guy’s guy,” his costar Laura Innes told People for Clooney’s cover story. “That’s true, but he is also a dear, loyal friend who would do anything for you. It’s almost like being a family member.”
1998 — Harrison Ford

“Star Wars” and “Indiana Jones” franchise star Ford won the title in 1998 when he was 56. “Why this sudden outpouring for geezers?” the famously gruff actor asked People at the time. “I never feel sexy. I have a distant relationship with the mirror.”
1999 — Richard Gere
After winning a “Sexiest Couple” title with then-wife Cindy Crawford in 1993, Gere won the Sexiest Man Alive title on his own six years later when he was 50.

Some of the “Pretty Woman” star’s former girlfriends talked to People about Gere’s appeal. “He walked like a biker, and that attracted me. I knew I was going to get my hands on him. I seduced him,” recalled designer Diane Von Furstenberg.
2000 — Brad Pitt
Pitt was named the Sexiest Man Alive for the second time in 2000, becoming the first man to earn the title twice.
2001 — Pierce Brosnan
Brosnan won the title in 2001 during the years he was portraying James Bond on the silver screen.

Julianna Margulies, Brosnan’s co-star in the drama “Evelyn,” told People at the time that the Irish actor’s sexiest quality was his love of his family. “When you see a gorgeous man holding hands with his wife and holding his baby, there’s nothing more sexy in the world,” she said.
2002 — Ben Affleck
Affleck was in the midst of his first romance with future wife Jennifer Lopez when he was crowned with the Sexiest title in 2002.

Kevin Smith, who directed Affleck and Lopez in “Jersey Girl,” tried to explain his longtime pal’s appeal to People at the time. “Chicks gravitate to him,” said Smith. “The word on the street is that he’s the ideal man, chatty, gorgeous, generous and intelligent.”
2003 — Johnny Depp
Depp first won the title in 2003 and would win it again six years later, becoming the third celebrity to win the honor more than once.
2004 — Jude Law
British star Law won the tile in 2004 after starring in “The Talented Mr. Ripley,” “Cold Mountain” and more blockbuster hits.

Law’s “I (Heart) Huckabees” co-star Naomi Watts gushed about the actor’s good looks to People at the time. “He’s the most beautiful man who ever walked the earth — an absolutely perfect oil painting.”
2005  — Matthew McConaughey
In the early aughts, actor Matthew McConaughey was predominantly a romantic comedy star, appearing in films like “How to Lose A Guy in 10 Days,” “The Wedding Planner” and “Failure to Launch.”
In an interview with People at the time, he gave them some colorful quotes like “I’ve got no trouble making a tree house.”
“I will be the first to find the groove,” he also told the outlet. “I mix some salsa moves in. No lessons; all freestyle.”
He’d go on to marry Camila Alves McConaughey in 2012 and they’ve welcomed three children together.
2006 — George Clooney
Clooney won the coveted title for a second time in 2006. He was only the second man to do so at the time, following Brad Pitt.

“This one’s going to be hard for Brad (Pitt) since he’s been Sexiest Man Alive twice. He’s enjoyed that mantle,” Clooney joked at the time. “I’d say ‘Sexiest Man Alive’ to him and he’d go, ‘Two-time.’ So that’s been taken away. We used to call him Two Time. So Brad’s going to be upset.”
2007 — Matt Damon

“George Clooney and Brad Pitt have shamelessly campaigned for him since 2001, but all it takes is one look at Damon’s piercing blue eyes, crooked smile and family-guy demeanor to understand why he has been chosen,” the magazine said in a statement announcing Damon’s win.
2008 — Hugh Jackman
“Oh … my … God,” Jackman’s costar Nicole Kidman told the outlet at the time. “Women’s jaws drop when Hugh walks into a room.”
Jackman, in his interview, celebrated his then-wife Debora-lee Furness.
He said that when he told Furness of his new title, she replied that she said she “could’ve told them that years ago!’”
“And then she said, ‘Obviously, Brad (Pitt) wasn’t available this year,’” Jackman recalled. “And I said, ‘That was a joke, right?’”
Furness and Jackman announced their split in September 2023 after 27 years of marriage.
2009 — Johnny Depp
The second time he won the title of Sexiest Man, Depp joined an elite club of just two other men — Clooney and Pitt.
People described Depp as “the king of cool with the killer cheekbones” in a statement at the time.

“Whether it’s onscreen in roles like Captain Jack Sparrow in the Pirates of the Caribbean franchise or at home with his family on their private Bahamian island, the 46-year-old father of two with 25 years in show business still reigns as Hollywood’s most irresistible iconoclast,” People said in a statement.
2010 — Ryan Reynolds

The first Canadian to win the title of Sexiest Man Alive was Ryan Reynolds, who told People that he runs five miles several days a week as a part of his normal training regimen but if he’s bulking up for a film, he’s only allowed to lift weights.
“My body naturally wants to look like Dick Van Dyke,” he said. “So I have to eat a lot: protein, carbs, all that kind of stuff.”
When asked what his immediate reaction was to finding out he’d won the coveted title of Sexiest Man of the Year, he said the following:
“Well, there was a little moment of disbelief, and then you kind of settle into it. Really, you just have to go with the flow.”
2011 — Bradley Cooper
After his win in 2011, Cooper told People that his mother “is going to be so happy.”
The article notes he graduated from Georgetown and is fluent in French — alongside his other acting accolades.

“I think it’s really cool that a guy who doesn’t look like a model can have this (title),” he told People. “I think I’m a decent-looking guy. Sometimes I can look great, and other times I look horrifying.”
2012 — Channing Tatum
The year Channing Tatum won the coveted title was the same year he starred in “Magic Mike,” as a (obviously very fit) male stripper.
He told People he was still surprised he made the cut, however.
“My first thought was, ‘Y’all are messing with me,’” he told the outlet.
2013 — Adam Levine
Maroon 5 frontman and then-coach of NBC’s “The Voice,” Levine said he was surprised to be given the title but thankful.

“As a musician, you have fantasies that you want to win Grammys, but I didn’t really think that this was on the table,” the singer told People at the time. “I was just amazed and stunned and it almost seemed like they were kidding, but they weren’t, so that’s cool.”
He also revealed in his interview that he was ready to settle down with his then-fiancee Behati Prinsloo.
“I didn’t think marriage was for me for a long time,” he told the outlet, then 34. “I was ready when I was ready. That’s about as simple as it could possibly be.”
The two have since welcomed three children together.
2014 — Chris Hemsworth
Australian Hemsworth quipped at the time that his new title “bought me a couple of weeks of bragging rights around the house.”

The actor joked he could tell his wife, Spanish model Elsa Pataky, “’Now remember, this is what the people think, so I don’t need to do the dishes anymore, I don’t need to change nappies. I’m above that. I’ve made it now.’”
The Marvel star and Pataky share daughter India Rose and twin boys Sasha and Tristan.
2015 — David Beckham

Soccer star David Beckham has long been a sex symbol but he didn’t take home the title of Sexiest Man until 2015. In an interview with People at the time, he said he doesn’t really think of himself as attractive.
“I never feel that I’m an attractive, sexy person,” he told the outlet. “I mean I like to wear nice clothes and nice suits and look and feel good, but I don’t ever think of myself that way.”
Beckham said his wife, Victoria Beckham, seemed to agree with the title, however.
“I would hope that she feels this way about me all the time anyway!” he said. “But she said, ‘Congratulations!’”
2016 — Dwayne “The Rock” Johnson
Johnson’s title was revealed on “The Ellen DeGeneres Show“ after the comedian politely roasted him for his early fashion choices.
Johnson then said that the new title of Sexiest Man probably wouldn’t change his day-to-day life much.
“I can tell you now that what this means is that I still have to drive in my pickup truck and change Jasmine’s diapers, but now I’m just the Sexiest Man Alive (too),” he quipped to DeGeneres.
2017 — Blake Shelton
Country music star Blake Shelton was somewhat of a surprise choice for the title, many people at the time felt.
Initially, Shelton seemed to pick up on this, joking to People for the issue that he’d “been ugly my whole life. If I can be sexy for a year, I’m taking it!.”
Later, he read mean tweets about himself aloud on an episode of “The Ellen DeGeneres Show.”
His favorite, he said, was this:
“We may be living in a time of division and strife but at least People magazine has united us in our certainty that Blake Shelton is not the sexiest man alive.”
2018 — Idris Elba
When Elba won his title, he told People that his children are his greatest joys and that he tries to live his life with as few regrets as possible.

“Life isn’t about thinking about what you should have done,” Elba said at the time. “I think everyone should adopt the philosophy that tomorrow is not promised so just go for it today, man. You might as well do it to your heart’s content.”
2019 — John Legend
Legend, then a coach on NBC’s “The Voice,” revealed his new status as Sexiest Man Alive during, fittingly, an episode of the singing show.
At the time, Legend joked that after sitting next to Shelton while on the show, he “learned his sexy ways.”
“I observed every move he made, every utterance that came from his mouth and I think some of it rubbed off on me,” Legend quipped.

We should also mention that in addition to being considered sexy by People and online voters, Legend is one of the few artists who can be called an EGOT. He’s won all four major showbiz awards — with an Emmy, several Grammys, a Tony and an Oscar to his name.
2020 — Michael B. Jordan
The then-33-year-old “Black Panther” star said it was his mom who was most excited about him winning the title, while his friends were going to roast him.

“Any one of my guy friends, everybody in the group chat — the group chat is gonna go crazy when this comes out. I mean the jokes aren’t gonna stop so it’s gonna be pretty ... entertaining, trust me,” he laughed in an interview with People TV. “I’ll snap shot a couple of them and post them because they’re brutal group chats.”
2021 — Paul Rudd
Famous Hollywood nice guy Paul Rudd was named People’s Sexiest Man Alive in 2021 at the age of 52.

His new title was revealed on “The Late Show with Stephen Colbert” as part of an elaborate prerecorded scene in which Colbert acted as a “sexiness adjudicator” before finally announcing Rudd’s new title.
In his cover story interview with People at the time, Rudd joked he is “going to lean into” his coveted new title. “I’m going to own this,” he said.
He also said that his wife of 18 years, Julie, was the only person he told in advance of the big reveal and she was “stupefied.”
2022 — Chris Evans
When Chris Evans won the highly-coveted title in 2022, he joked that his mom was the most thrilled to have bragging rights.
His mom told the magazine she was “not surprised at all” that her son was voted sexiest.
“Our family will be beside themselves,” she told People at the time.
Evans himself thought the title would just become “a point of bullying.”

“It’s ripe for harassment,” he said at the time. When the outlet asked him how he felt about using the word “sexy” to describe himself, he said that “It’s something that as I become old and saggy I can look back on and say ‘I remember then…’ I’m lucky to be in the discussion in any capacity.”
In his year as the sexiest man, he starred in three movies: “Red One” “Ghosted” and “Pain Hustlers.”
He also married Portuguese actor Alba Baptista, to whom he’d been tied to since 2022.
2023 — Patrick Dempsey
In 2023, the Sexiest Man Alive was revealed on “Jimmy Kimmel Live” to be actor Patrick Dempsey.

“I’m glad it’s happening at this point in my life,” the former “Grey’s Anatomy” star said to People. “It’s nice to have the recognition, and certainly my ego takes a little bump, but it gives me the platform to use it for something positive.”
2024 — John Krasinski
John Krasinski was awarded the title of People’s Sexiest Man Alive in 2024.
The news was announced on “The Late Show with Stephen Colbert” on Nov. 12, 2024, when “The Office” star made an appearance on the late-night program.
“Look at him, I get it,” Colbert said while referring to Krasinski.
In an interview with People, Krasinski revealed his reaction when he learned he was receiving the honor. He said he felt “immediate blackout” and thought he was being “punked.”
“That’s not how I wake up, thinking, ‘Is this the day that I’ll be asked to be Sexiest Man Alive?’ And yet it was the day you guys did it. You guys have really raised the bar for me,” he told People.
As for how his wife, actor Emily Blunt, felt about his title, he said she was “very excited” when she heard the big news.
“There was a lot of joy involved in me telling her,” he said.
2025 — Jonathan Bailey
Jonathan Bailey delivered the “Bridgerton” franchise its first Sexiest Man Alive award when he was announced as the recipient in 2025.
Bailey, who was busy promoting the sequel “Wicked: For Good” at the time, was revealed as the magazine’s sexist man on the Nov. 3, 2025 episode of “The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon.”
“It’s an honor of a lifetime,” Bailey said as his two covers, including one featuring his adorable dog Benson, were unveiled.
The actor made history as the first openly gay person to receive the honor.
“In 2025, I’m sort of thrilled that People magazine have invited someone in, to bestow this honor on someone who can really cherish the value of a sexy man,” he cheekily said.
Bailey playfully added that he “f------ hopes” he is treated differently now that he can add this title to his list of accolades.
2026 — Noah Wyle
The “Pitt” star, who has won two consecutive Emmy Awards for his role on the hit HBO drama, was blown away when he found out he was named Sexiest Man Alive.
“I thought that sounded like a prank — just not in a million years did I think that this would be an honor bestowed on me,” he told People.
Wyle’s former “ER” co-star, George Clooney, is a two-time Sexiest Man Alive winner. So what would Clooney have to say about Wyle joining the club as a sexiest man himself?
“I think he’ll be amused and feel, hopefully, like a proud papa, that I’ve come of gray-haired age,” Wyle said.
And while he may be easy on the eyes, Wyle possesses other skills beyond his ability to act, too. Does that make him even dreamier?
“It sounds odd, but I have a talent for catching flies live. Catch and release. I have really very, very fast hands,” he said.

title: Jay-Z Will Headline Super Bowl LXI Halftime Show
summary: Jay-Z decided he has found the perfect entertainer to headline this season’s Super Bowl halftime — himself.
story: Jay-Z decided he has found the perfect entertainer to headline this season’s Super Bowl halftime — himself.

The legendary rapper has been announced as the headliner of the halftime show at Super Bowl LXI, which is slated to take place on Feb. 14, 2027, at SoFi Stadium in Los Angeles, the home of the Rams and Chargers.
“GOAT’s out of the bag,” the official Apple Music X account posted Oct. 26, along with a clip that shows the rapper sitting in the empty stands.

“When we first reached an agreement with Roc Nation to produce the show, I had just one request: that JAŸ-Z take the stage himself one day, whenever the moment felt right to him,” NFL Commissioner Roger Goodell said in a statement. “I couldn’t be more excited for fans around the world to experience the artistry, creativity and cultural impact he will bring to the Super Bowl stage.”

Jay-Z has overseen the musical direction of the halftime show since the NFL struck a deal with his entertainment company Roc Nation in 2019. The halftime concert featured Jennifer Lopez and Shakira in the first year under his guidance in 2020.
The 56-year-old rapper has enjoyed a renaissance in 2026 as he celebrates the 30th anniversary of his debut album, “Reasonable Doubt” with sold-out shows from Yankee Stadium to Paris.

With Jay-Z headlining, that raises the possibility he could be joined onstage by a host of collaborators, including his wife, Beyoncé. She headlined her own Super Bowl halftime in 2013 and returned as a special guest during Bruno Mars’ halftime show in 2016. She and their daughter, Blue Ivy, also joined Jay-Z onstage at one of his “Reasonable Doubt” shows in July.

Jay-Z’s Valentine’s Day performance will follow the show-stopping set by Bad Bunny at Super Bowl LX on Feb. 8 at Levi’s Stadium in Santa Clara, Calif. The Puerto Rican star was the first Spanish-language solo artist to headline the Super Bowl halftime show, which is one of the biggest stages in music.

The 2026 performance also included appearances from Lady Gaga and Ricky Martin. Other stars made cameos on the field, including actors Pedro Pascal and  Jessica Alba and Atlanta Braves’ player Ronald Acuña Jr.

Bad Bunny’s halftime set averaged 128.2 million viewers between 8:15 and 8:30 p.m. ET, according to Nielsen. It also broke records for viewership on social media while the Seattle Seahawks were busy beating the New England Patriots 29-13 for their second Super Bowl title.
“The top three most-viewed NFL social posts in history are now Apple Music Super Bowl LX Halftime Show clips,” NBC said in a news release.
Recent halftime headliners have also included Kendrick Lamar, Usher, Rihanna and Dr. Dre and Snoop Dogg.

title: Chrishell Stause Announces Split From G Flip After Over 4 Years Together: ‘I Feel Like a Little Bit of a Failure’
summary: Chrishell Stause has revealed that she and partner G Flip are separating after more than four years together.
story: Chrishell Stause has revealed that she and partner G Flip are separating after more than four years together.
The 45-year-old actor and reality television star shared the news about the breakup in a tearful video uploaded to Instagram Oct. 26.
“I have a pretty humbling update to share with you guys,” Stause began. “G and I are no longer together, and we have agreed to treat this public separation with love and respect for each other.”
She continued, “That’s not hard for me because I am in love with this person, and I don’t have all the information or the reasons.”
The “Selling Sunset” alum said she hopes that as time goes on she will heal and learn from the relationship.
“Everything’s going to be fine. I’m definitely never doing this again,” she said. Stause was previously married to actor Justin Hartley from 2017 to 2021.

She explained that she recorded the video message because fans “deserved a little bit more than a cold written statement” after showing their love and support for the couple for years. She said their fans can still offer support, but they will have to do so separately now.

“I don’t know what else to say, you guys. I feel like a little bit of a failure. There’s nothing you could say about me that would be worse than what I say to myself. So I just have to kind of heal and figure this out,” Stause said as she started to cry.
She further explained how she is currently processing the breakup.

“I’m a lover girl. I swing big. I miss…” she said before correcting herself. “Or maybe you don’t miss. Maybe these are the lives and seasons you’re meant to have with people, and I had an amazing over four years with G.”
Although the relationship is ending in a way she didn’t expect, she added that she will always love her ex and wishes them both happiness.

G Flip posted a statement on their Instagram page that read, “After 4+ years Chrishell and I are no longer together. I will always love her, we will always share a special connection and I cherish our memories together deeply. My head & heart are feeling very heavy right now and I’m not able to talk but I want to thank you all for your support and appreciate you respecting our privacy at this time.”
Stause and G Flip, 33, met at a Halloween party in 2021, the Australian musician revealed to Vogue Australia. “Chrishell got stood up and then we ended up kissing,” they shared.
The actor confirmed their relationship during the Season 5 “Selling Sunset” reunion in May 2022.

“I recently have been spending a lot of time with someone that’s very important to me. Their name is G Flip,” Stause said at the time. “They’re nonbinary, so they go by they/them, and they are an extremely talented musician.”
A year later, they married in a surprise wedding. Stause posted a video on Instagram of them tying the knot. The clip included a montage of their relationship.
“Love doesn’t always go as planned … Sometimes it’s immeasurably better,” she said in the caption, in part.

They continued to have more ceremonies over the past few years. In July 2025, they exchanged vows for a fourth time during their medieval-themed nuptials in Los Angeles. Stause’s representative confirmed to TODAY.com at the time that the ceremony also marked the couple’s third anniversary.

title: ‘Nobody Wants This’ Stars Timothy Simons and Justine Lupe Have Opinions on Sasha and Morgan
summary: Justine Lupe and Timothy Simons share their takes on the “Nobody Wants This” Season 3 love triangle between Esther, Sasha and Morgan.
story: Warning: Spoilers ahead for “Nobody Wants This” Season 3.
In its third season, “Nobody Wants This” goes from a love story to a complicated love triangle.
Noah (Adam Brody) and Joanne (Kristen Bell) have solved their main relationship issues. Their siblings, meanwhile, are just stepping into their own mess.

Questioning whether their long marriage is still serving her, Esther (Jackie Tohn) asks Noah’s brother Sasha (Timothy Simons) for a separation. The separation leaves Sasha reeling — and free to acknowledge the undeniable crackle he shares with Joanne’s sister, Morgan (Justine Lupe).
During a trip to New York, Sasha and Morgan finally act on the spark audiences have long sensed between them. (As we said, complicated!)
In an interview with TODAY.com, Simons says he was “excited” for his character to finally cross that boundary with Morgan.

“Story-wise, I think it’s one of those things that’s been there for a while. If you don’t address it, it’ll just end up hanging too long. An audience would be like, ‘Why aren’t you addressing this?’ I feel like they addressed it in a responsible and earned way,” he says.
After spending the night together, Morgan abruptly takes an early flight home to Los Angeles, leaving Sasha stranded and confused in a New York hotel.

Morgan, after initially wrestling with her feelings, tries to win Sasha back over. But it might be too late. By then, Sasha has become more measured. He also sleeps with Esther, muddling matters further.
Lupe, speaking to TODAY.com, thinks Sasha and Morgan’s story would have been different if she hadn’t left him in New York.
“It gave him a moment to get reasonable, for where he’s at and how he can properly take care of himself. If she had not left, he probably would have been swept up,” she says.

Simons says Sasha is at a crossroads between two kinds of love. There’s the “safety and familiarity” of Esther, with whom he shares a daughter and years of history — “but is it the most emotionally healthy relationship for either one of them?”

Simons says there’s a chance Esther and Sasha wouldn’t make the same decisions about their relationships. “They got together pretty young. Maybe they wouldn’t make the choice to be together now,” he says.
Whereas Morgan and Sasha are both “weirdo, kindred spirits that fit the same role in their families.“
More on "Nobody Wants This"

“I feel like they just understand each other in a very interesting way that nobody else in their family does, and I think that’s one of the things that draws them to each other,” he says.
As for what’s next? Lupe says she “doesn’t have a strong opinion.”
Simons says he does have an opinion, but he’s keeping it secret (for now).
“I’m not a writer. I’m not a director. It might not be the best thing for the show. That’s out of my hands. But I do have a personal opinion,” he says with a smile.

title: Matthew Perry’s Sister Says This 1 Thing is Always a Sign From Her Late Brother
summary: Matthew Perry’s sister Mia Perry Bowick said she thinks of this one thing as a sign from her late brother, Matthew — it’s a Batman.
story: It’s been three years since Matthew Perry passed away, but his sister, Mia Perry Bowick, says she still feels his presence.
During an appearance on TODAY on Oct. 26, Bowick described Perry as a “constance presence” in her family’s lives. “I do still talk to him,” she said.
Bowick went into more detail while speaking to TODAY.com, saying that she feels Perry connects with her through one sign.
“My favorite sign for Matty is anything I see with Batman on it. I have a Batman tattoo,” she tells TODAY.com, adding that signs from her brother “show up constantly.”

The “Friends” star was found dead on Oct. 28, 2023. His cause of death was later revealed to be the acute effects of ketamine, with contributing factors including drowning, coronary artery disease and the effects of buprenorphine, a medication that’s used to treat opioid use disorder.
Bowick opens up about her late brother’s life and career in three-part Netflix docuseries titled “The One About Matthew Perry,” out  Oct. 27.
While speaking with TODAY.com, she explained that she associates Batman signs with her brother since he was “obsessed” with the character.

“Ever since he was a little boy, it was just always his favorite superhero, and he just was very connected to him. He had all sorts of really incredible paraphernalia around Batman, and he just loved him. It’s just like an automatic association anytime I see the little Batman symbol,” she says.
Bowick, a licensed psychotherapist, said she regularly broaches the topic of the power of signs from loved ones with her own patients.

“I talk about that a lot in my grief practice: how we can choose to decide that these signs mean something so that it can give you that little boost during the day that you might need, versus like, ‘Oh that couldn’t possibly (be a sign).’ It was like, ‘Well it could, and wouldn’t it be nice to believe that (and) maybe choose that?’ And it kind of gives you a little bit like the warm fuzzies,” she says.
Perry left a lasting impact on his family, but he also influenced the lives of many others, as the director Mary Robertson discovered while working on the docuseries.

“I was really struck at some point in the production by the number of people we were interviewing who had an era with Matthew, and that could be one year or two years or 10 years. And they would routinely, time and again, describe this era as the high point of their lives,” she tells TODAY.com.
“I think Matthew’s influence is incredibly deep and incredibly wide,” she adds.

title: The ‘Sunrise on the Reaping’ Cast Is Torn Between These Matching Tattoo Ideas
summary: A few members of the “Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping” cast are considering commemorating their roles in the film in a special way.
story: A few members of the “Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping” cast are considering commemorating their roles in the film in a special way.
Joseph Zada, Mckenna Grace and Whitney Peak stopped by Studio 1A on Oct. 26 to discuss the highly anticipated “Hunger Games” prequel and said they’ve toyed with the idea of getting matching tattoos.
“Well, first of all, we did all want to get 12s,” Grace tells TODAY.com.

In the film, Zada and Grace play two of the children selected, or “reaped,” to represent District 12 in the 50th Hunger Games. Because it is a Quarter Quell, the amount of tributes in the game are doubled.

Zada plays 16-year-old Haymitch Abernathy, a character who later serves as Katniss Everdeen’s mentor in the original “Hunger Games” film. Grace plays Maysilee Donner. District 12’s other tributes are Wyatt Callow, played by Ben Wang, and Louella McCoy, played by Molly McCann.
Peak plays Lenore Dove Baird, a District 12 resident, member of the Covey and Haymitch’s girlfriend.

To remember the film, which opens in theaters Nov. 20, some members of the cast want to get matching tattoos. But getting everyone on board proved to be a bit challenging. At present, only two people are fully on board: Zada and Grace.
“Whitney did never agree, to be fair. Ben agreed,” Zada says.
“Ben did agree. But then he gets a little wishy-washy on us and then he changed his mind,” Grace adds.
Then they had to decide on a design.
“It was supposed to be 12s for all of us, and then Joe and I are still the only two who still want to get tattoos,” Grace says.
“Now it’s little ladybugs, isn’t it?” Peak asks.

The actors thought “it would be sweet” to get a ladybug. In the book, Haymitch and Maysilee eventually become allies, and one of the first obstacles they face together in the arena are mutated ladybugs that dig into their skin.
Now that they’ve narrowed things down to two potential tattoo ideas, Grace and Zada say they have to determine where they’ll get their ink.
“We can’t decide where because Mckenna doesn’t want it on her ankle, and I don’t want it anywhere else,” Zada says.
“I wear too many heels,” Grace quips.
One thing’s for sure, though. Grace has made it clear that their matching tattoos have to be in the same place on their bodies.
“I have three matching tattoos and it always has to be in the same place,” she says.

title: I’m an ‘ACOTAR’ Obsessive. Here’s What to Actually Revisit Before Reading Book 6
summary: A book influencer, a journalist and two podcast co-hosts share how they’re preparing for “A Court of Splintered Harmony.”
story: “Take It From Me” is a TODAY.com series where experts use their wisdom to explain trends or make recommendations within their fields. In this story, a book influencer, a journalist and two podcast co-hosts share how they’re preparing for the next book in the “A Court of Thorns and Roses” series.
Warning: Spoilers ahead for Sarah J. Maas’ books.

Buckle in, “A Court of Thorns and Roses” fans: “A Court of Splintered Harmony” hits shelves Oct. 27, reuniting readers with the Night Court for the first new “ACOTAR” novel in five years. You know what this means: It’s officially crunch time.

The last book, 2021’s “A Court of Silver Flames,” wraps up relatively neatly: Nesta learns to weather her trauma while training to become one of the forgotten female warriors, the Valkyrie; Feyre and Rhysand have a baby; and Cassian and Nesta fall in love and accept their mating bond.

The synopsis for “Splintered Harmony” hints at lingering conflicts, both in and outside of the Inner Circle, that have yet to take center stage. And clocking in at 352 pages, it’s just the beginning of the next phase of the story, what author Sarah J. Maas is calling “The Valkyrie Cycle.” This book, as well as the already announced “ACOTAR” 7, “A Court of Forgotten Melody,” will be part of this arc.
Essentially, readers are in for plenty of new content — and with a new villain on the horizon.
For this recap of the most important things to remember headed into the next “ACOTAR” installment, TODAY.com caught up with four experts for their takes:

Sarah Mori, a book influencer who runs a 5,000 person+ Sarah J. Maas book club called Rosebud’s Realm on Discord and has re-read each of Maas’ books at least three times.Ronnie Boswell and Abby Flock, co-hosts of the romantasy podcast “Dragons in the Details,” which dives into fan theories and lore explanations for “ACOTAR,” “Crescent City” and Rebecca Yarros’ “Fourth Wing” series.Garri James, senior managing editor and book club co-host at The Everygirl, who wrote her own bullet point recap of the entire “A Court of Thorns and Roses” series.
Sarah Mori, a book influencer who runs a 5,000 person+ Sarah J. Maas book club called Rosebud’s Realm on Discord and has re-read each of Maas’ books at least three times.

Ronnie Boswell and Abby Flock, co-hosts of the romantasy podcast “Dragons in the Details,” which dives into fan theories and lore explanations for “ACOTAR,” “Crescent City” and Rebecca Yarros’ “Fourth Wing” series.
Garri James, senior managing editor and book club co-host at The Everygirl, who wrote her own bullet point recap of the entire “A Court of Thorns and Roses” series.
Here are the details they say are worth remembering before diving into the next book.
More of Sarah J. Maas

Characters

Koschei, primed to be the “ACOTAR” world’s next big enemy, is the only character named in the official synopses of “Splintered Harmony” and “Forgotten Melody.” He’s first mentioned by name in “A Court of Wings and Ruin,” when the Bone Carver is describing how he and his siblings “fell” into Prythian.
“We have to remember that the Bone Carver, the Weaver — they are Koschei’s siblings,” Mori says.
Click here for a deep dive on what to know about Koschei.
Boswell and Flock both predict Vassa, one of the human queens who comes to the aid of Prythian forces at the end of “Wings and Ruin,” will be a major player going forward.
“I think she’s going to be really important and play a big role in the next book, and I’ve seen almost no one talking about her,” Flock says.

In “Mist and Fury,” Vassa is the sixth queen missing from a summit with Rhys in the Mortal Lands. Her fellow queens lie and say she is sick. It’s later revealed Vassa opposed the queens’ plan of allying with Hybern in the last war, so they sold her to a “sorcerer-lord,” later revealed to be Koschei. Elain, made a seer by the Cauldron, sees that Vassa is confined to a lake and has been cursed to be a firebird by day, a woman by night.
Vassa is kept captive by Koschei along with other women, except “their feathers are white as snow,” according to Elain. “They glide across the water — while she rages through the skies above it.”

But somehow, the Archeron sisters’ father negotiates with Vassa’s captor to free her, and she sails into battle with his fleet to attack Hybern. In “Frost and Starlight,” it’s revealed other High Lords have been unable to break her curse. And in “Silver Flames,” she’s seen hiding out with Jurian and occasionally Lucien, representing an alliance between mortals and Fae, even as the queens stir.
“Koschei has just let (Vassa) continue to be free and we have no idea why,” Boswell adds.
In addition to serving as an emissary to Jurian and Vassa, Lucien has been in limbo, as Elain has yet to accept their mating bond.
